# 3suns

> 3suns is professional astrology software for Mac and Windows, published by Karia LLC. Charts, forecasts, traditional timing, primary directions, astrocartography, Vedic charts and client reports in one window, with planet positions checked to 0.01 arc seconds against the Swiss Ephemeris. It runs natively on Macs with Apple Silicon or Intel and on Windows 10 or 11. Charts are kept on the user's computer; no account is needed. A licence key is required.

## Pages

- [Home](https://3suns.app/): what 3suns does, with screens of the app
- [Download](https://3suns.app/download): installers for Mac (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Windows 10 or 11, frequently asked questions and the full feature list
- [Privacy policy](https://3suns.app/privacy): charts stay on the user's computer; the app only goes online for its licence key and updates; the website counts visits without cookies

## Key facts

- Systems: macOS 11 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon or Intel; signed by Karia LLC and notarized by Apple) and 64-bit Windows 10 or 11, including Windows tablets. No iPad or Android app yet.
- Charts: natal, event and moment charts; transits with a time stepper; secondary, tertiary, minor and user-rate progressions; solar arc, Naibod, one-degree, Ascendant and Vertex directions, with converse; solar, lunar and planet returns; synastry, composite, Davison and harmonic charts; relocated charts; multiwheels with up to three rings.
- Wheel: 8 built-in chart styles and your own saved styles; a full aspect grid with every point, the angles and parallels; rectification with a birth time stepper; print, copy, or save as PNG, SVG or PDF.
- Settings: Lilly's orbs by default, or your own orbs by planet or by aspect; 11 house systems; tropical or sidereal; geocentric, topocentric or heliocentric; mean or true node; Chiron, the main asteroids and 15 more; Vertex, Uranian points; 49 fixed stars.
- Forecasting: a year timeline with exact dates, stations, ingresses, lunations and eclipses, void-of-course Moon, declination parallels, a month calendar, a graphic ephemeris and an electional search.
- Traditional: almutens, essential dignities, Lilly's accidental dignities, receptions, antiscia, 15 Arabic parts, planetary hours, profections, firdaria and zodiacal releasing, with your own almuten, term and triplicity methods.
- Primary directions: Placidus semi-arc, Placidus under the pole and Regiomontanus in zodiaco; Placidus, Regiomontanus and Campanus in mundo; Naibod, Ptolemy, Cardan, own-rate and true solar arc keys; direct and converse; latitude on the ecliptic, the planet's own or by Bianchini's rule; Part of Fortune, antiscia and fixed stars as promissors; speculum and CSV export.
- Mapping: planetary lines in mundo or zodiacal, parans and local space; 90, 45 and 360 degree dials; midpoint trees.
- Vedic: South and North Indian charts, Lahiri, Raman, Krishnamurti and other ayanamsas, nakshatras and padas, 16 divisional charts and Vimshottari dashas.
- Notes: notes and predictions linked to charts and points, kept as Markdown files.
- Reports: Natal, Year Ahead and Relationship reports as PDF with the astrologer's own branding.
- Import and export: Solar Fire chart files (.SFcht) open directly, with notes, Rodden ratings and life events. Saved charts from astro.com can be pasted in as AAF text. AAF, CSV and JSON import and export.

## Common questions

- Can I open my Solar Fire charts on a Mac? Yes. 3suns runs natively on Mac and opens Solar Fire chart files (.SFcht) directly, with their notes, Rodden ratings and life events. It runs on Windows too.
- Which astrology software for Mac calculates primary directions? 3suns calculates primary directions in zodiaco and in mundo (Placidus, Regiomontanus and Campanus) with a choice of keys and latitude rules, natively on Mac and Windows.
- Does 3suns need an account or an internet connection? No account. Charts stay on the computer. The app goes online only to check its licence key and to look for updates.
- How accurate is it? Positions and house cusps are tested against the Swiss Ephemeris reference program to 0.01 arc seconds, and time zones come from the IANA database, including historical changes and local mean time.
